title: Kanda 15: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 15.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 15.

verses.original: व्रात्य आसीदीयमान एव स प्रजापतिं समैरयत् ।
verses.transliteration: vrātya āsīdīyamāna eva sa prajāpatiṁ samairayat |
verses.translation: There was the Vratya, the spiritual wanderer; he stirred Prajapati to cosmic manifestation.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The Vratya Sukta: elevating the ascetic wanderer who transcends rigid dogmas into a sovereign cosmic guide.

layers.author: whitney
layers.content: सायण भाष्य: There was the Vratya, the spiritual wanderer; he stirred Prajapati to cosmic manifestation.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: अथर्ववेद काण्ड 15: The Vratya Sukta: elevating the ascetic wanderer who transcends rigid dogmas into a sovereign cosmic guide.
